coverage_summary: Global scan covered energy and Gulf logistics, infrastructure, payments, capital access, production and AI financing, trade and critical-mineral policy, labour/institutions, and market-access changes. Saudi export recovery and tanker adaptation reduce immediate scarcity risk but do not yet demonstrate durable scale or accessibility sufficient to change a canonical Atlas state. U.S.-China AI dialogue and the September 23-25 summit are diplomatic catalysts without an implemented structural change in trade, technology controls or critical-mineral access. Vietnam's FTSE emerging-market inclusion is a market-access milestone, but this run did not establish a sufficiently evidenced actor-specific structural mechanism beyond index eligibility to create an Atlas candidate. SoftBank's large AI-linked bond financing is observable capital access but is company-specific rather than a new country-level structural condition. No candidate crossed the material-delta threshold.
